not_claimed: No generic impossibility for full-column or nonlinear common-word binders.
No theorem that every noisy modular endpoint row-span evaluator is short.
No attack on standard LWE or SIS.
No completed generic-NP PQ witness KEM.
No claim that a compiler must fingerprint semantically redundant witness bits.
proved_claim_scopes: The signed-diagonal false target has no global word but every proper target-column subset has a local word.
Independent proper-subset share release, including leave-one-out N-of-N composition, can be spliced using different local words on that false target.
For the concrete noisy restricted affine transport, each false local route has the same telescoping form and bounded signed-ternary noise as an honest local route.
In scalarized affine transport, two valid words with distinct scalar fingerprints place the bare shared endpoint functional in the public transport row span.
The explicit one-layer alpha=(1,2) fixture yields the short public noisy endpoint identity 2*C0-C1=R1+2*E0-E1.
title: proper-subset path coupling and scalar fingerprint collapse
